name: Dark Prison Haunted House
address: 3301 E 5th St, Carson City, NV 89701, USA
photo_attributions: Photo by kinzie rose hunter via Google Maps; Photo by Leon Vieira via Google Maps; Photo by Jon Fish via Google Maps
activities: Cellblock C haunt; Unit 15 haunt; Institute for the Unwell haunt; Photo ops; Carnival-style games; Live actor interactions; Behind the Screams tour (special event); Flashlight Night (special event); Live DJ; Projection mapping; Bar/The Shiv Bar; Food trucks
extra_notes: Timed ticketed event with very limited time slots that usually sell out every night. Not recommended for children 12 and under without adult supervision; children under 5 not permitted. Flashing lights, loud sounds, and strong scents used. No touch policy. No costumes or face-covering masks allowed. Metal detectors and security at entrance. Free parking (3 lots). VIP tickets available with additional perks including 20-minute behind-the-scenes tour and 1 free drink. Partially wheelchair accessible with staff assistance available. Sign waiver required before arrival. Special events (Opening Weekend Sept 25-26, Behind the Screams tours, Flashlight Night Nov 1) have separate tickets and limited capacity.
